CATALOGUE_METER_PICKER.LABEL: Pick from the meter catalogue
CATALOGUE_METER_PICKER.PLACEHOLDER: Pick a catalogue meter, or type a new key below
EXISTING_METER_RATES_FIELDS.AMOUNT_MIN: Every band in {{currency}} needs a per-unit amount of zero or more.
EXISTING_METER_RATES_FIELDS.BANDS_ASCEND: {{currency}}'s bands must ascend — each "up to" must be greater than the one before it.
EXISTING_METER_RATES_FIELDS.HEADING: Overage rates
EXISTING_METER_RATES_FIELDS.HINT: What usage past each meter's allowance costs. Nobody already subscribed is repriced: overage is rated from what was on the plan when they signed up, so this reaches only future subscriptions and future renewals.
EXISTING_METER_RATES_FIELDS.NO_BANDS: {{currency}} has no bands. Add at least one, or remove the currency.
EXISTING_METER_RATES_FIELDS.SAVE_FAILED: The rates could not be saved.
EXISTING_METER_RATES_FIELDS.TOO_MANY_DEC: {{amount}} {{currency}} has more decimal places than the currency allows.
METER_PACE_FIELDS.BOUNDARY_DAY: Each day runs midnight to midnight, UTC — not from when the subscriber signed up.
METER_PACE_FIELDS.BOUNDARY_HOUR: Each hour runs on the clock, 09:00 to 10:00 and so on — not from when the subscriber signed up.
METER_PACE_FIELDS.BOUNDARY_WEEK: Each week runs Monday to Monday — not from when the subscriber signed up.
METER_PACE_FIELDS.INTRO: Caps how fast the allowance is spent, not how much of it. An allowance with nothing shorter than the billing period can be spent in an afternoon. A use has to fit every limit here as well as the included amount.
METER_PACE_FIELDS.REPORTING_HINT: Reporting slows nobody down by itself — the caller is told it is over pace and decides what to do, e.g. fall back to a cheaper model.
METER_PACE_FIELDS.ROLLING: Rolling — the last {{span}} from right now, not a window on the clock
METER_PACE_FIELDS.ROLLING_EXPLANATION: A rolling window ends now and looks back — spend right up to the cap, wait, and the oldest use ages out and makes room again.
METER_RATE_TABLE_FIELDS.AMOUNTS_HINT: Amounts are in {{currency}} — {{example}} means {{example}} {{currency}} per extra unit.
PLAN_BUILDER.CHECK_FIELDS_DESCRIPTION: Some steps still have something to fix before this can be saved.
PLAN_BUILDER.FIX_STEP_DESCRIPTION: Taken to the first field that needs attention.
PLAN_BUILDER.SAVE_FAILED: This plan could not be saved.
PLAN_BUILDER_PROGRESS.HINT: Complete each section, then review your plan.
PLAN_BUILDER_PROGRESS.LABEL: Plan creation progress
PLAN_PRICE_FIELDS.AMOUNT_HINT_YEARLY: What a year costs, in major units. The monthly price below prices only the opening period.
PLAN_PRICE_FIELDS.DISCOUNT_HINT: Applied without a code, for as long as the subscription stays on this price.
PLAN_PRICE_FIELDS.DISCOUNT_SAVE_FAILED: The discount could not be saved.
PLAN_PRICE_FIELDS.HEADING: How much does it cost?
PLAN_PRICE_FIELDS.HINT: The recurring charge itself, separate from any overage above. Add one per billing cadence you sell — monthly and annually are two prices.
PLAN_PRICE_FIELDS.HINT_EDIT: Prices are separate from the plan's terms, so the ones it already has are left alone. Anything added here is created alongside your edit.
PLAN_PRICE_FIELDS.MULTIPLIES_HINT: Flat fee charges the same whatever the quantity. Per unit multiplies the amount above by the units held.
PLAN_PRICE_FIELDS.NO_COMPATIBLE_MONTHLY: This plan has no compatible monthly {{currency}} price yet. The opening period is charged from one, so it has to match this price's currency, quantity item and tax before it can be chosen. Add and save one first.
PLAN_PRICE_FIELDS.OPENING_PERIOD_HINT: The opening period is a fraction of this price, counted in calendar days.
PLAN_PRICE_FIELDS.RATE_HINT: A percentage. Leave empty for no tax.
PLAN_PRICE_FIELDS.RETIRE_HINT: Retiring stops a price being sold. Anyone already on it keeps their terms and their renewals — a subscription bills from what it was sold on, not from this list. Prices keep immutable amount, cadence and billing-cycle terms; only tax and automatic-discount metadata can be edited, and only for future subscriptions and future moves onto the price. To move a plan onto a different billing cycle, add a new price and retire this one.
PLAN_PRICE_FIELDS.APPLY_TO_EXISTING_SUBS: Also apply to existing subscribers from their next renewal at least 7 days away. They will be emailed about the change.
PLAN_PRICE_FIELDS.STUB_PREVIEW: A signup on 25 August pays 7/31 of {{amount}} for the rest of the month. Any automatic discount below applies to that opening period as well as to the year; a promotional code applies to the year alone.
QUANTITY_DISCOUNT_TIERS.BAND_HINT: The band is chosen by the total quantity, and its discount applies to the whole charge — not only to the units inside the band. A discount code, if one is used, combines according to the plan's combination policy.
QUANTITY_DISCOUNT_TIERS.CONFIRM_REMOVE: Remove the volume bands on this item? The discounts you entered are lost.
QUANTITY_DISCOUNT_TIERS.LAST_BAND_HINT: The last band covers a single quantity, so it cannot be split again.
QUANTITY_DISCOUNT_TIERS.NOTHING_TO_BAND_: This item allows only no quantity, so there is nothing to band. Raise its maximum to offer a volume discount.
This item allows only one quantity, so there is nothing to band. Raise its maximum to offer a volume discount.
STEP_CREDITS.CURRENCY_HINT: A subscriber is offered credits only in their subscription's currency. At 0.10, 100 credits cost 10.00.
STEP_CREDITS.DESCRIPTION: Optional. Let subscribers buy more of a meter up front, at a price per credit. Bought credits are used after the plan's own allowance runs out, and before any overage.
STEP_CREDITS.EXPIRY_CARRY_FORWARD_DESCRI: Unused credits roll into each renewal, and are lost when the plan changes.
STEP_CREDITS.EXPIRY_FIXED_DESCRIPTION: Credits last a set time from the moment they are bought, whatever the billing calendar does.
STEP_CREDITS.EXPIRY_NEVER_DESCRIPTION: Credits last as long as the subscription and this meter do.
STEP_CREDITS.EXPIRY_PERIODIC_DESCRIPTION: Credits not used by the end of the window they were bought in are lost.
STEP_CREDITS.LARGEST_PURCHASE_HINT: Bounds what one purchase can charge.
STEP_CREDITS.NO_METERS: Add a meter in the pricing step first. Credits are sold for a meter the plan counts.
STEP_CREDITS.PAUSED_HINT: Paused. The terms are kept, and nobody can buy until you switch this back on.
STEP_CREDITS.TITLE: Sell extra credits
STEP_IDENTITY.CODE_HINT: Shown to no one but your own systems — the stable id you'll call this plan by. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores only.
STEP_IDENTITY.CODE_HINT_FIXED: Fixed once the plan exists — this is what your own systems call it by.
STEP_IDENTITY.DESCRIPTION: The basics: what this plan is called, and who it's for.
STEP_IDENTITY.DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: What this plan is for, in a sentence.
STEP_IDENTITY.DISPLAY_NAME_HINT: Shown to subscribers wherever the plan appears.
STEP_IDENTITY.FAMILY_CODE_HINT: Plans with the same family code are levels of one product.
STEP_IDENTITY.FAMILY_RANK_HINT: Lower levels sort first; required when family code is set.
STEP_IDENTITY.FEATURES_HINT: Arbitrary feature flags, stored verbatim and handed back untouched — nothing here interprets it. Leave blank unless your own product reads this field.
STEP_IDENTITY.ORGANIZATION_HINT: Which organization this plan belongs to. Scope it to one organization only when it shouldn't be offered to everyone.
STEP_IDENTITY.ORGANIZATION_HINT_FAILED: Organizations could not be loaded; you can still create a tenant-wide plan.
STEP_IDENTITY.ORGANIZATION_HINT_FIXED: Fixed once the plan exists — moving it would take the plan out from under whoever can see it.
STEP_IDENTITY.SCOPE_HINT: An organization can hold both kinds at once, e.g. shared capacity plus per-person AI usage.
STEP_IDENTITY.SCOPE_HINT_FIXED: Fixed once the plan exists — the server keeps the scope it was created with.
STEP_IDENTITY.SCOPE_ORGANIZATION_DETAIL: One subscription everybody in the organization shares.
STEP_IDENTITY.SCOPE_USER_DETAIL: The organization buys places and gives one to each person; every place gets its own allowance.
STEP_IDENTITY.TITLE: Identity
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.ALLOWANCE_PERIOD_HINT: How long one allowance lasts. Independent of how often you bill — a yearly price can still grant a monthly allowance, and usually should.
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.ALLOW_OVERAGE: Allow going over the included amount (billed as overage)
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.CARRY_CAP: Most {{unit}} one period may carry in
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.CARRY_CAP_HINT: Caps what rolls in, not the total — the included amount is always available on top. Required, because without a ceiling a dormant subscription banks allowance indefinitely. The most a subscriber can ever hold in one period is the included amount plus this cap.
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.DECIMAL_PLACES_HINT: Leave at 0 for whole numbers only. Raise it when the unit is measured rather than counted — gigabytes, hours. Set 1 to allow 512.5, or 3 to allow 512.505; more decimals than this are rejected.
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.DESCRIPTION: Add any quantity and usage dimensions this plan needs. A flat-fee plan needs neither.
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.DISCOUNT_CODE_POLICY: When a subscriber also has a discount code
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.LIFETIME_NO_OVERAGE: Lifetime capacity stops at its included amount and is not billed as monthly overage.
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.METERS_HINT: Use meters to track an allowance and optionally bill usage beyond it.
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.NO_OVERAGE_PRICE: No price set, so usage past the allowance is billed nothing.
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.PAYMENT_METHOD_HINT_O: A plan that costs nothing today starts straight away. Nothing has a card on file until the first charge, which is a problem only if there will be a later one.
The subscriber is sent to a card form that charges nothing. Nothing is granted until the card is stored, so the next period has something to bill.
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.PLACES_FLAT: Priced flat — everybody pays the same, so the quantity says nothing about how many people there are. Max is the only number that can, and without one nobody can be given a place at all.
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.PLACES_INTRO: This plan is for each person, so one of these quantities has to say how many people.
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.PLACES_PER_UNIT: Priced per unit — the quantity bought is the answer. Five bought, five people. A maximum is optional.
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.POLICY_HINT: Compounding gives away more than either discount alone, so choose it deliberately. A code that loses to a band is not spent.
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.QUANTITY_ITEMS_HINT: Use these when price scales with seats, users, or another selected quantity.
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.REQUIRE_PAYMENT_METHO: Require a payment method before activation, even when nothing is due today
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.TITLE: Pricing model
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.TRIAL_MAX_HINT: Most a trialing subscriber may hold. Units added during the trial up to this are free. Blank: the trial covers only what was bought at signup.
STEP_PRICING_MODEL.UNUSED_HINT: Choose “Does not apply” for capacity that must remain consumed after renewal, or let it roll into the next period instead.
STEP_REVIEW.DESCRIPTION: This is exactly how the plan will read once it's created.
STEP_REVIEW.TITLE: Review
STEP_TRIAL.CARD_HINT: A card is saved now without a charge. The first paid period is charged when the trial ends.
STEP_TRIAL.DESCRIPTION: Optional. Choose “No trial” for a plan that charges from day one.
STEP_TRIAL.GRANTS_HINT: Give a trial its own allowance for a meter instead of the plan's normal one — useful when the regular allowance would be an open invitation to sign up, consume and leave. Works on a lifetime-capacity meter too: the grant governs the trial, and the plan's own quantity takes over the moment it converts.
STEP_TRIAL.KIND_END_OF_MONTH: Until the end of the calendar month
STEP_TRIAL.KIND_END_OF_MONTH_DESCRIPTION: Until the end of the calendar month; late signups may receive a short trial.
STEP_TRIAL.KIND_MONTHS_DESCRIPTION: Same local date and time after N months.
STEP_TRIAL.NO_CARD_HINT: The trial starts without a card. A payment method is required before paid access can continue.
STEP_TRIAL.NO_TRIAL_HINT: A plan that charges from day one.
STEP_TRIAL.ONE_TRIAL_PER_PLAN_OFF_HINT: Every signup gets the trial, including an organization that cancelled and comes back.
STEP_TRIAL.ONE_TRIAL_PER_PLAN_ON_HINT: Each organization gets the trial once, whoever buys it. Subscribing again after cancelling goes to paid checkout.
STEP_TRIAL.REQUIRE_CARD: Require a card to start the trial
STEP_TRIAL.TITLE: Trial
STEP_USAGE_LIMITS.DESCRIPTION: What a subscriber on this plan is allowed to do — separate from what they're billed for. Skip this if the plan just grants everything.
STEP_USAGE_LIMITS.TITLE: What the plan grants
